# DSH Bridge (dsh-vsc)

> DSH Bridge is a VS Code extension that connects to DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — a local AI agent service — as a **protocol client**. It provides a native sidebar panel plus an editor bridge (ask-about-selection, review-agent-changes) without rewriting DSH or starting a second server. It is a "pure bridge": it consumes DSH's wire contract, not its UI, so it stays robust when DSH updates. Targets the DSH 0.2.1 line (Typert Remote); no runtime patching is involved.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, fork additions, installation, quick start, configuration, notes. (English)
- [docs/design.md](docs/design.md): Deep architecture & "pure bridge" philosophy — written from zero domain knowledge, with a 90-second explainer and Q&A for skeptics.
- [src/README.md](src/README.md): Source tree map — what lives in `src/editor`, `src/events`, `src/harness`, `src/panel`.
- [src/harness/README.md](src/harness/README.md): Harness client / discovery / launcher notes.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): How to build, test, and contribute.

## Key source files

- [src/harness/client.ts](src/harness/client.ts): ~200-line minimal protocol client (no DSH internals).
- [src/harness/protocol.ts](src/harness/protocol.ts): Wire-contract types & endpoint names (single source of truth).
- [src/panel/protocol.ts](src/panel/protocol.ts): Panel message protocol — events forwarded losslessly.
- [src/harness/overlay/deltas.ts](src/harness/overlay/deltas.ts): The 4 overlay deltas (source of truth).
- [src/harness/overlay/loader.ts](src/harness/overlay/loader.ts): ESM in-memory loader (swap source, log, degrade).
- [src/harness/overlay/pristine.ts](src/harness/overlay/pristine.ts): Official SHA-256 table + integrity self-check.
- [src/harness/launcher.ts](src/harness/launcher.ts): Start DSH (NODE_OPTIONS injection, PID record).
- [src/extension.ts](src/extension.ts): Activation/shutdown logic (reference-counted harness stop).
- [src/panel/NativePanelProvider.ts](src/panel/NativePanelProvider.ts): The native sidebar panel provider.
- [src/panel/native/panel.html](src/panel/native/panel.html): The hand-built panel UI.
